programme.title: Classic Premier League
programme.sub-title: The best goals of the 2005/06 season
programme.desc: A look back at the best goals from the 2005/06 season. Thierry Henry became the first player in the league's history to win the Golden Boot four times, top-scoring with 27 goals.

programme.title: Classic Premier League
programme.sub-title: The best goals of the 2006/07 season
programme.desc: A look back at the best goals from the 2006/07 season. Chelsea's Didier Drogba topped the scoring charts with 20 goals, ahead of Benni McCarthy (18) and Cristiano Ronaldo.

programme.title: Classic Premier League
programme.sub-title: A look back at the best goals from the 2007/08 season
programme.desc: A look back at the best goals from the 2007/08 season. Cristiano Ronaldo topped the scoring charts with a remarkable 31 goals, ahead of Fernando Torres and Emmanuel Adebayor on 24.

programme.title: Classic Premier League
programme.sub-title: The best goals of the 2008/09 season
programme.desc: A look back at the best goals from the 2008/09 season. Chelsea striker Nicolas Anelka secured the Golden Boot with 19 goals, beating Cristiano Ronaldo to the prize.

programme.title: Classic Premier League
programme.sub-title: The best goals of the 2009/10 season
programme.desc: We revisit the best goals from the 2009/2010 season. In his most prolific season for Chelsea, Didier Drogba secured the Golden Boot with 29 goals, three ahead of Wayne Rooney.

programme.title: Classic Premier League
programme.sub-title: The best goals of the 2010/11 season
programme.desc: A look back at the best goals from the 2010/2011 season. Dimitar Berbatov and Carlos Tevez shared the Golden Boot with 20 goals, ahead of Robin van Persie who finished with 18.

programme.title: Classic Premier League
programme.sub-title: The best goals of the 2011/12 season
programme.desc: A look back at the best goals from the 2011/12 season. With 30 goals, Robin van Persie won the Golden Boot in his final season for Arsenal, finishing three ahead of Wayne Rooney.

programme.title: Classic Premier League
programme.sub-title: A look back at the top strikes from the 2012/13 season
programme.desc: A look back at the top strikes from the 2012/13 season. Robin van Persie finished top of the charts with 26 goals, three ahead of Luis Suarez and five in front of Gareth Bale.

programme.title: Classic Premier League
programme.sub-title: A look back at the top goals from the 2013/14 season
programme.desc: A look back at the top goals from the 2013/14 season. Luis Suarez - in his final season at Anfield - finished top scorer with 31 goals, 10 ahead of team-mate Daniel Sturridge.

programme.title: Classic Premier League
programme.sub-title: A look back at the most memorable goals from the 2014/15 season
programme.desc: A look back at the most memorable goals from the 2014/15 season. Sergio Aguero won the Golden Boot with 26 goals, five ahead of Harry Kane and six in front of Diego Costa.

programme.title: Classic Premier League
programme.sub-title: A look back at the top goals from the 2015/16 season
programme.desc: A look back at the top goals from the 2015/16 season. Harry Kane beat Sergio Aguero and Jamie Vardy to the Golden Boot, while Watford's Odion Ighalo and Troy Deeney also impressed.

programme.title: Classic Premier League
programme.sub-title: A look back at the best goals from the 2016/17 season
programme.desc: A look back at the best goals from the 2016/17 season. Harry Kane won the Golden Boot for the second successive season with 29 goals, scoring seven goals in Spurs' last two games.

programme.title: Classic Premier League
programme.sub-title: A look back at the best goals from the 2017/18 season
programme.desc: A look back at the best goals from the 2017/18 season. Liverpool's Mohamed Salah held off Harry Kane to clinch the Golden Boot, as both players reached 30 goals.

programme.title: The Sentinel

programme.title: Arctic

programme.title: Black Knight

programme.title: Elektra

programme.title: Noah

programme.sub-title: Pippi Goes Up in a Balloon

programme.title: Pippi Longstocking: Pippi Goes to the South Seas
programme.desc: Captain Longstocking docks in the village to pick up Pippi and take her with him to the South Seas. Annika and Tommy are given permission to go along and they all set sail for adventure on the high seas.
programme.sub-title: Pippi Goes to the South Seas

programme.title: Pippi Longstocking: Pippi Meets Some Pearl Poachers

programme.title: Kung Fu Dino Posse

programme.title: Kung Fu Dino Posse

programme.title: Class of the Titans: Eye for an Eye

programme.title: Sabrina's Secret Life: Teacher's Pet
